context: Tests whether the skill causes the agent to correctly configure a Kubernetes sidecar collector pattern. Sidecars provide pod-level isolation but require careful resource allocation and understanding of when to use sidecar vs. DaemonSet/Gateway patterns.

checklist.name: Defines collector container in pod specification
checklist.description: The pod template includes the collector as a container in spec.containers[], not as a separate pod. Score zero if collector is deployed separately.

checklist.name: Configures localhost networking between app and collector
checklist.description: The configuration uses localhost:port for app-to-collector communication. Both containers share the pod's network namespace enabling localhost access.

checklist.name: Allocates shared resources appropriately
checklist.description: Pod-level resources accommodate both app and collector. Collector requests should be 10-30% of app resources. Partial credit if only total pod resources are specified.

checklist.name: Includes logging and health checks for collector
checklist.description: The collector container includes readiness/liveness probes and logging configuration for troubleshooting failures. Score zero if health checks are omitted.

checklist.name: Explains sidecar trade-offs vs. DaemonSet/Gateway
checklist.description: The response discusses when to use sidecar: (1) per-pod isolation, (2) custom per-pod configuration, (3) cost vs. scaling trade-offs. Score zero if trade-offs are not mentioned.

checklist.name: Recommends sidecar for specific use cases only
checklist.description: The response recommends sidecar only for specific scenarios (high isolation needs, custom sampling per workload, strict resource constraints). Score zero if sidecar is suggested as default for all cases.
